_note: Curated Book of Mormon names - see scripts/build_bom_names.py's docstring for the tiers and rules. Meanings and proposals are this project's own summaries; the build links each name's Onomasticon page. Add "people": "jaredite" for a Jaredite name. "notes" are study notes (wordplay, titles, nicknames). "families" group names sharing consonants or an element; each member's card links the others.
